source.workflow_job: Game Atlas Physical Profile Spike / validate

fixture_policy: project-owned deterministic synthetic data only; no OTBM/Crystal/Canary/Tibia assets

derived_observations.json_vs_jsonl: Synthetic compressed-size differences are negligible; size alone does not select between them.
derived_observations.floor_packing: Packed-floor layouts reduce total compressed bytes modestly but multiply single-floor point/viewport bytes by approximately the number of synthetic floors; per-floor packaging is the stronger locality baseline for a floor-oriented Atlas consumer.
derived_observations.chunk_size: 64x64 reduces file count and total compressed bytes versus 32x32, while increasing one-point and representative viewport bytes; consumer workload evidence is required to select the trade-off.
derived_observations.binary_baseline: The research binary baseline is smaller, especially raw, but the synthetic compressed advantage alone is insufficient evidence to introduce a public binary schema or dependency.

smallest_missing_owner_evidence.needed: A canonical Game spatial/coordinate profile that freezes axes/orientation, numeric coordinate domain and bounds, floor identity/domain/order, valid point/bounds semantics, deterministic same-position ordering/stack-layer semantics, and presentation anchor/displacement semantics where canonical presentation references require them.
smallest_missing_owner_evidence.why_blocking: OTERYN_GAME_ATLAS_EXPORT_CONTRACT_V1 requires these semantics before an executable producer/consumer may claim coordinate-profile compatibility, while current executable Position evidence is explicitly non-authoritative client projection and the workspace has no canonical world-schema implementation to promote.

non_authority: No serializer is selected by this report.
No chunk size or floor packing is selected by this report.
No production resource limit is established by this report.
No canonical coordinate/floor numeric range is established by this report.
binary-baseline-v0 is not a proposed public schema.
SHA-256 and gzip are measurement mechanisms in the spike, not accepted Game -> Atlas production profiles.
